editor.sandboxPolicyHint: Controls the external agent process on its execution host. Agent-specific permission settings can restrict access further.
editor.sandboxPolicyWindowsInert: Inactive on Windows: the required external-agent OS sandbox is unavailable, so local process launches are refused. Saved policy settings do not enable sandbox support.
editor.sandboxPolicyWindowsNote: These settings are inert on Windows, where local external-agent process launches are currently unavailable.
editor.sandboxAllowedHostsHint: One host per line. Exact hostnames, IP literals, or *.domain patterns; no schemes, paths, or ports. A wildcard does not include the domain itself. Only HTTP proxy traffic and HTTPS CONNECT tunnels are supported; private and metadata addresses remain blocked.
editor.sandboxAllowedHostsInvalid: Enter valid exact hosts or *.domain patterns without schemes, paths, ports, or trailing dots.
editor.sandboxAllowedHostsEmpty: An empty allowlist disables network access.
editor.sandboxReadableHint: Workspace scope also permits the agent’s state, its installed toolchain, package-runner cache and Git configuration. Protected credentials stay denied in both scopes.
editor.codexWorkspaceAccessHint: Network access and extra writable folders apply only when the effective permission mode is Accept edits (workspace write). These settings belong to this Cognia agent and do not inherit native Codex configuration.
editor.codexWorkspaceAccessInactive: Inactive under the current default permissions or sandbox mode. These settings apply only to workspace-write runs; saved values are retained for per-run permission overrides.
editor.codexWritableRootsDesc: One absolute folder path per line. Invalid or protected paths are ignored and reported at launch; accepted folders are limited by the session sandbox writable ceiling.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What this configuration is for, e.g. read-only reviews
editor.invalidMaxSessions: Maximum sessions must be a whole number above zero, or empty for no limit.
editor.invalidIdleTimeout: Idle timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds above zero, or empty to use the execution timeout.
editor.sessionsSummaryLimited: {count, plural, one {Up to # session} other {Up to # sessions}}
editor.maxSessionsHint: How many sessions this configuration keeps open at once. Opening one more first closes the least recently used idle sessions; a new session is refused only when every open one is busy. Leave empty for no limit.
editor.idleTimeoutHint: How long a running turn may go without any output before it is stopped. Leave empty to use the execution timeout.
editor.approvalsIntro: Rules for the permission requests this agent sends to Cognia. "Always ask for" wins over "Approve without asking".
editor.approvalSyntax: Each entry is a tool name, or Tool(pattern) to match only some calls, e.g. Bash(git *) or Edit(src/**). * and ? are wildcards. Entries match the request's tool name, title or kind (execute, edit, read).
editor.requireApprovalForHint: Shown to you even in modes that would approve them. In Don't ask mode they are denied.
editor.autoApproveHint: Approved without a prompt unless an "Always ask for" rule also matches.
editor.approvalInvalid: Use a tool name or Tool(pattern), with the closing parenthesis.
editor.approvalBypassNote: In Bypass mode some runtimes (Codex among them) never ask, so there is nothing for these rules to govern.
editor.accountHint: The Codex account this configuration signs in with. Following the active account uses whichever one is active in Subscriptions when the agent starts.
editor.accountUnavailableWeb: Binding a subscription account needs the desktop app; this configuration follows the active account.
editor.accountLoadFailed: Couldn't read your subscription accounts ({error}). The current binding is kept.
editor.accountNone: No Codex accounts yet. Add one in Subscriptions to bind it here.
editor.secretSaved: A value is saved in the keyring. Type a new one to replace it.
editor.secretWillRemove: The saved value will be removed when you save.
editor.secretClearFailed: The agent was saved, but the stored secret could not be removed: {error}

delegation.deleteDescription: Chat turns will no longer be routed by this rule. This cannot be undone.
delegation.noEnabledDescription: Enable an agent before automatic routing can run.
delegation.disabledTargetHint: This rule will not run until its target agent is enabled.
delegation.targetRequired: Select an agent that still exists.
delegation.matcherRequired: Enter a matcher for this condition.

hostConfigs.deleteDescription: The host removes this configuration and its stored credentials. Sessions it is running are ended. This cannot be undone.
hostConfigs.duplicateFailed: The host could not duplicate it: {error}

manager.sharedHistoryNotice: This agent shares its runtime state with {names}: one sign-in, one settings file and one session history, so sessions started from any of them are listed here.
